statement: With the finger hole open, the modelled note is within 10 cents of 470 Hz
rationale: 470 Hz is the top of the coo's rise as the person chose it (R2), and the one finger hole makes it (R5); the recordings support 470 Hz (input coo-pitch-analysis: in one Paris recording a third of the loudest-partial energy lies within 25 Hz of it). 10 cents is the same centring tolerance for the model as in C1, for the same reasons. The interval a hole makes is the best-conditioned part of the model, +-1 to 3 % in ratio on published instruments (input vessel-flute-acoustics-notes, section 3). A played note is C22's question.

mechanism.how: The passive resonance of the designed geometry with the finger hole and the vent open, found twice as for C1: the closed form in the model and the potential-flow solve. Both must land within the limit, and both are run only while the chamber is short beside the wavelength (C7).
